name: Shin-Itabashi
tagline: Otemachi in 20 minutes and Tokyo in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 20 minutes to Otemachi, 28 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 28.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 28.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 17.4 m to 28.8 m, a difference of 11.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 愛誠病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 帝京大学医学部附属病院, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line.
congestion: Toei Mita Line runs at 146% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Itabashi; for lower rent, Shin-Itabashi.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shin-Itabashi. Itabashi has the JR Saikyo Line, a different set from Shin-Itabashi. To Shinjuku, for instance, Itabashi is 17 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥10,000 more at Itabashi. On quiet, Itabashi comes out ahead.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shin-Itabashi. Shimo-Itabashi has the Tobu Tojo Line, a different set from Shin-Itabashi. To Shinjuku, for instance, Shimo-Itabashi is 12 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥11,000 more at Shimo-Itabashi. On quiet, Shimo-Itabashi comes out ahead.

People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
中山道 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Mita Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
